definition: For each action independently, previous 30 or 60 rows contain no press of THAT action. Other action/camera activity is allowed. Current labels are excluded from the history. Prior own-action press channels must be fully known/valid; run-boundary and unknown-history rows are excluded. First current press in quiet-history rows is an onset; recent-own-press rows are continuations.
metric_note: Original run coordinates and +/-1 one-to-one matcher; true and predicted presses restricted to the same action stratum. Quiet-history false positives count against onset F1. Boundary-permitting recall additionally allows a prediction across the onset/continuation boundary and can credit a one-frame late echo. Macro F1/recall use zero for actions without positives. EDGE_ACTIONS macro matches the confirmation metric; live-actions macro is secondary. All semantic actions shown with their TRAIN live-mask status.
precision: float32 heads; completed float16 feature cache
